core_obligations: By etale localization reduce to Y = Spec(A) with A a Noetherian domain; let B be the integral closure of A in its fraction field and C = Gamma(X, O_X).
X is normal by the regular-implies-normal lemma, so C is a normal domain; since B is contained in C and C is finite over A with A Noetherian, B is finite over A.
There is a nonempty open V of Y with f^{-1}V -> V finite by the alteration definition; shrink V so that f^{-1}V -> V is flat by generic flatness, hence faithfully flat.
Conclude V is regular by faithfully flat descent of regularity, giving the dense regular open.
proof_roadmap: Etale localization to the affine case; finiteness of global sections; normality of sections; containment argument for B; generic flatness to faithful flatness; descent of regularity.
difficulty_reason: Two constructions in one proof: the normalization finiteness via the sections ring C, and the regular dense open via generic flatness plus descent.
